status_meaning.automated: The criterion is covered by executable repository tests; node scripts/check.mjs runs them.
status_meaning.external_evidence_required: Repository tests check the preconditions; the required real-world evidence must be produced and archived outside the repository.

criteria.criterion: Name lists are demonstrably effective: "Tischlerei Josef Brandstetter e.U." is recognized with the list; without the list the case may fail.

evidence.asserts: A/B run without and with the encrypted registry; only with the list is the company name confirmed as ORGANIZATION from master_data.
The four-stage pipeline runs through with stage 0 (name lists).

criteria.criterion: The suspicion check is demonstrably effective: an unknown, unusual name appears as a question card "Looks like a name – but was not recognized".

evidence.asserts: "Gebrüder Wachtelhuber" is reported as a suspicion.

evidence.test: Milestone E: review three files, switch, keep, add, decide
evidence.asserts: The question is numbered in the document and shown as a card in the questions panel.

criteria.criterion: Fail-closed: if processing fails, no partial result is saved; dropping files and saving are blocked, reading stays possible.

evidence.asserts: The sidecar returns no findings before the terminal success state.
After a hard crash no stale job folder remains.
A total NER failure ends as a failed file without findings and without document text in responses or diagnostics.
An unusable name list blocks health and submitting.

evidence.test: Fail-Closed: a glitch during review blocks saving but not viewing
evidence.asserts: If the shell reports the outage, saving is blocked; the document stays readable, and saving works again after recovery.

criteria.criterion: All styles work: codes, invented names, placeholders, blackout and remove produce the expected result for the same document; encryption and one-way checksum stay in the sidecar and are tested.

evidence.asserts: Each of the five styles replaces name and IBAN as expected, carries the matching label, and the saved file matches the apply result.
All seven processing modes return the operator and the reversibility facts.

criteria.criterion: PDF "remove": after saving, the removed text can neither be selected nor extracted; the render check is mandatory.

evidence.asserts: True redaction with no selectable or extractable remainder.
Through /entries/{id}/save: text, words and raw characters without the name, render and text checks ran, original unchanged.
A PDF is only provided after the render check has passed.

criteria.criterion: Categories take effect: the default leaves places and dates in place, "all categories" replaces them too; account, ID and access data are always included; "Keep only here" and "Keep all …" work per occurrence and per entry respectively.

evidence.asserts: Account data only, the default and all categories give the three expected versions.
The locked category is always part of the masking spec.
Overrides work in both directions.

evidence.test: never shows locked categories as whole (E3)
evidence.asserts: The code menu offers no "Keep all …" for locked categories.

criteria.criterion: The "Anonymous" label only with "Anonymize", without a plaintext exception and without a residual-risk finding; never otherwise. The protected term appears in no Svelte file.

evidence.asserts: With residual risk it stays "Irreversible", without a finding "Anonymous", with "Keep only here" it is "Irreversible" again (blocker kept_here).
anonymize holds exactly for the irreversible method with all categories.

evidence.test: does not appear as a literal in any Svelte file
evidence.asserts: No Svelte markup contains the stem of the protected term.

criteria.criterion: Residual-risk check: a document that still contains a date, an amount and an article number after redaction triggers the notice.

evidence.asserts: The real processor reports three classes and blocks the strongest label.

criteria.criterion: Round trip: mask text, send the codes through a language model, resolve the answer again – lossless, tolerant of changed spelling and also after a restart.

evidence.asserts: Saved codes are resolved from a changed spelling after a restart of the sidecar.
Missing brackets, upper/lower case and spaces still lead unambiguously to one code.
A saved scan: the text layer survives restoring with changed spelling and missing brackets, every value comes back, no code is unknown. With a real local model: scripts/llm-round-trip.py --scan.

criteria.criterion: Three manual interventions (keep an occurrence, add, correct a boundary) end up in the result, in the review report and in the audit log.

evidence.asserts: Apply and save through API v2; audit with REJECT, ADJUST_SPAN and ADD_MANUAL.

evidence.test: corrects boundaries as a pair and then restores them
evidence.asserts: The UI sends a boundary correction as a pair of keep and add.

criteria.criterion: Negative tests for every custom recognizer: no pattern reaches across word boundaries.

evidence.asserts: The matrix names every custom type.
No custom recognizer swallows neighboring words.

criteria.criterion: No outgoing network traffic from the running native app – except during a model download the user started, and then only to the hosts of the source.

evidence.test: starts without external network and matches visual reference
evidence.asserts: The UI loads only from the local origin and stays stable offline.
The bundle is checked for external sources.
The downloader accepts only HTTPS to the hosts of the source.
Redirects to foreign hosts abort.

external_check.why: Playwright sees only WebView requests and the Rust test only the downloader. A capture must also cover the sidecar, the shell, DNS and native libraries.
external_check.procedure: Start an acceptance-grade, signed package with an empty network cache; begin a capture of all non-loopback interfaces before starting (macOS: sudo tcpdump -i any -n "not host 127.0.0.1 and not host ::1" -w run.pcapng); drop documents, review, save, restore an AI answer, open settings, quit the app. In a second run, also download a language pack.
external_check.pass_condition: Run 1: no DNS, TCP, UDP or QUIC traffic from the app's process group except loopback. Run 2: traffic only during the download and only to the hosts of the chosen source.
external_check.artifact: PCAP/PCAPNG of both runs plus operating system, package hash, time window and capture filter.

criteria.criterion: Review works fully with the keyboard; focus order follows the picture, also in the floating bars; contrast 4.5:1 in light and dark; axe (WCAG 2.1 AA) reports nothing on every board.

evidence.test: Review works fully with the keyboard
evidence.asserts: Tab through the codes, Alt+N, Alt+M, Escape, hold Space.

evidence.test: Focus order: Document, floating toolbar, question panel – menu returns focus
evidence.asserts: Top, document, bottom bar, questions panel; the masking menu returns focus.

evidence.test: defines every token in both modes without cycles
evidence.asserts: All text/surface pairs are checked against their minimum ratio in both modes.
axe-core (loaded offline) with WCAG 2.1 AA rules per board in light and dark, plus the reference image.

criteria.criterion: Hardware acceptance on 8 GB RAM / 2 cores under Windows 11 x64.

evidence.asserts: The runtime matrix sizes the CPU and OCR pools for small devices.

evidence.test: Check Windows 11 x64 and minimum hardware fail‑closed
evidence.asserts: The package smoke test checks the minimum hardware fail-closed.

external_check.why: Mocks and CI configuration prove neither memory pressure nor runtime and usability on the limit device.
external_check.procedure: Run package-smoke on the self-hosted Windows 11 x64 device limited to 2 cores and 8 GB; then repeat the reference flow by hand (first-run setup, review documents with PDF/scan, save, restore) and run scripts/performance.py there.
external_check.pass_condition: Installation, first-run setup, CPU processing, review, saving and restoring without OOM, hangs or GPU dependency.
external_check.artifact: Workflow run link with runner metadata, package hash, logs and the device's acceptance/performance.json.

criteria.criterion: Mappings only on save: toggling ten times and discarding leaves the translation table unchanged; saving writes exactly the codes that were used.

evidence.asserts: Ten dry runs, discard, no path around saving: table empty.
Only saving commits, with the origin of each code.

criteria.criterion: When in doubt, mask: an open question is masked on save and counted in the review report as "masked without a decision".

evidence.asserts: Open questions are masked in the result.
"keep" from the preview does not apply on save; count masked_without_decision.
An open PDF repetition is masked on save instead of blocking the export.

criteria.criterion: Restoring text and DOCX with codes from two entries and one unknown code.

evidence.asserts: Count here / other entry / earlier / unknown, nothing saved.
DOCX with formatting, lossless.

evidence.test: Milestone G: AI answer with codes from two entries, unknown code, nothing saved
evidence.asserts: The UI shows origin and count and saves nothing.

criteria.criterion: History: titles contain no recognized name; entries disappear when their retention period ends, the translation table stays.

evidence.asserts: Titles from the document kind and file names, without names.
The janitor deletes only expired entries.
The history exists only encrypted.

criteria.criterion: Document languages: a mixed DE/EN document paragraph by paragraph; an English contract from Vienna with Austrian numbers; placeholders in the language of the paragraph.

evidence.asserts: Paragraph-by-paragraph separation of DE/EN.
Austrian numbers in an English contract.
[Company] in the English paragraph, [Firma] in the German one.

criteria.criterion: Models: a file with a deviating checksum is discarded and reported; without models, dropping files is blocked (first-run setup).

evidence.asserts: The downloader discards a file with a wrong SHA-256.

evidence.test: Initial setup: a tampered file is rejected and reported
evidence.asserts: The first-run setup reports the discarded file.
Without models the sidecar reports setup_required.

criteria.criterion: Second opinion: fewer open questions at equal or better recall; every AI decision visible and reversible.

evidence.asserts: Without the "Keep" option the AI decides only toward protection.
AI decisions are counted separately in the review report.

evidence.test: Second opinion: AI box, “Resolved by local AI”, reversible
evidence.asserts: Visible and reversible with one click.
Measurement on the invented corpus: fewer open questions, recall 1.0.

criteria.criterion: Recall measurement as a release gate: a versioned corpus of at least 200 real, previously pseudonymized documents; precision, recall, false positives and false negatives with and without name lists; plus the second opinion on the same corpus.

evidence.asserts: The gate compares precision and recall per category with the baseline (recall may drop by at most 0.5 percentage points), with and without name lists.
The import contract for a real, previously pseudonymized corpus.

external_check.why: The versioned corpus in the repository is invented (3×200 synthetic documents). Spec 11 requires real, previously pseudonymized documents; those must not leave the operator's device.
external_check.procedure: For each area of use, select at least 200 real documents, pseudonymize them beforehand, import them with scripts/quality/import_real.py, and run scripts/quality/gate.py and scripts/second_opinion/measure.py locally.
external_check.pass_condition: Recall and precision per category reach the thresholds set in the gate, with and without name lists; the second opinion lowers the open questions without losing recall.
external_check.artifact: Content-free measurement report (only counts and metrics) with corpus hash, date and version.

evidence.asserts: 50 pages: detection, apply and save with redaction and render check within the limits.

An OCR over the saved scan finds no original value, only the codes.
Mandatory check: a removed value in the text layer aborts the export.
Mandatory check: a code once too often in the text layer or unreadable in the image aborts the export.
PNG/JPG stays an image, the code is in it as pixels; control image = saved file.
If the OCR does not read the code back, text is saved; the output reports readback_failed.

evidence.test: describes what happened to scans and images
evidence.asserts: Saved and the review report name the text layer or the fallback to text.
